title: Controller, keyboard and haptic navigation of drawn UI
blurb: Buttons drawn through a shader, with focus moved by arrow keys (focusgroup), a game controller or an on-screen direction pad. The shader magnifies and lights the focused button and leans the panel toward it. Each move asks for a vibration.
question: Can arrow keys, a game controller and an on-screen pad move real DOM focus through buttons that a shader draws, and can the shader show where focus is?
